The dead LDA zp_save+17 left on line 120 only sets A/N/Z, set again by LDA zp_save+19. Exit A = zp_save+33 and flags as before. Renderer-family sources have no writes to &9F/&A0/&B6 by name or literal (only game.6502 logic routines, and prebuild runs before save_game_zp).
